risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantified and transparent, reporting revenue declines, expense trends, cash balances, securities maturities, and contractual obligations. Key risks include declining contract and product revenue, dependence on government funding and existing customers, fluctuating R&D expenses, and sensitivity of valuation estimates. Liquidity appears strong, with management expecting adequate working capital through fiscal 2014, although several forward-looking caveats limit certainty.
